about: Ten questions written and locked before the BM25+lexicon rebuild. Do not edit expectations to match a worse ranker. A hit is any retrieved saying that overlaps the expected citation.

questions.text: I feel so alone since my divorce
My daughter is not speaking to me
I lied to my wife and I feel sick about it
I am jealous of my friend's success
What does Jesus say about money and greed
My boss humiliated me in front of everyone
I have been praying for years and nothing changes
How do I love people who are cruel to me
